meta.description.en: A 35B multimodal MoE model with 3B active parameters, hybrid attention, long context, and W8A8 deployment options on Ascend.
meta.description.zh: 35B 多模态 MoE 模型，每 token 激活 3B 参数，支持混合注意力、长上下文及多种昇腾 W8A8 部署方式。

meta.performance_headline.en: W8A8 serving on Atlas 800 A2/A3, Ascend 950DT, and Atlas 300I DUO
meta.performance_headline.zh: 支持 Atlas 800 A2/A3、Ascend 950DT 和 Atlas 300I DUO 的 W8A8 部署

features.spec_decoding.description.en: Qwen3.5-style MTP with three speculative tokens.
features.spec_decoding.description.zh: Qwen3.5 风格 MTP，每步使用三个候选 token。

features.model_runner_v2.description.en: Use Model Runner V2 for the A2/A3 tutorial configuration.
features.model_runner_v2.description.zh: 在 A2/A3 教程配置中使用 Model Runner V2。

features.prefix_caching.description.en: Reuse KV blocks for repeated prefixes.
features.prefix_caching.description.zh: 复用重复前缀对应的 KV 块。

variants.default.description.en: W8A8 quantized checkpoint for A2/A3 and Atlas 300I DUO.
variants.default.description.zh: 用于 A2/A3 和 Atlas 300I DUO 的 W8A8 量化权重。

variants.w8a8_mxfp8.description.zh: 用于 Ascend 950DT 的 W8A8 MXFP8 量化权重。

config_params.max_model_len.description.en: Maximum input plus output length of a request.
config_params.max_model_len.description.zh: 单条请求输入与输出的最大 token 数。

config_params.max_num_seqs.description.en: Maximum active sequences per DP group.
config_params.max_num_seqs.description.zh: 每个 DP 组的最大活跃序列数。

config_params.max_num_batched_tokens.des.en: Maximum tokens processed in one scheduler step.
config_params.max_num_batched_tokens.des.zh: 单个调度步骤处理的最大 token 数。

config_params.gpu_memory_utilization.des.en: Fraction of NPU memory available for model execution and KV cache.
config_params.gpu_memory_utilization.des.zh: 模型执行与 KV 缓存可使用的 NPU 显存比例。

overview.en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a multimodal sparse MoE model with 35B total parameters and about 3B active parameters per token. Its hybrid attention architecture supports long-context serving, W8A8 quantization, expert parallelism, and MTP.
overview.zh: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 是多模态稀疏 MoE 模型，总参数量为 35B，每 token 激活约 3B 参数。其混合注意力架构支持长上下文推理、W8A8 量化、专家并行和 MTP。

prerequisites[0].content.en:
The tutorial ships five weight versions. Pick the one that matches your hardware and fetch it with the weight tab above; this table records which versions exist and where each one is published.

| Weight version | Hardware requirement | Published on |
| -------------- | -------------------- | ------------ |
| BF16 (`Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B`) | 1 Ascend 950DT (96GB x 8) node, 1 Atlas 800 A3 (64GB x 16) node, 1 Atlas 800 A2 (64GB x 8) node, or Atlas 300I DUO | ModelScope |
| W8A8 (`Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w8a8`) | 1 Atlas 800 A3 (64GB x 16) node, 1 Atlas 800 A2 (64GB x 8) node, or Atlas 300I DUO | ModelScope |
| W8A8 MXFP8 (`Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w8a8-mxfp8`) | 1 Ascend 950DT (96GB x 8) node | ModelScope |
| W8A8C8 MXFP8 (`Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w8a8c8-mxfp8`) | 1 Ascend 950DT (96GB x 8) node | ModelScope |
| W4A8 MXFP (`Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w4a8-mxfp`) | 1 Ascend 950DT (96GB x 8) node | ModelScope |

The tutorial publishes every version on ModelScope, so ModelScope is the only download host listed. Download the weight to a shared directory such as `/root/.cache/` and record the path, because the deployment commands resolve the model from it.
prerequisites[0].content.zh:
教程提供五个权重版本。请选择与您的硬件匹配的版本，并在上方权重页签中下载；下表记录各版本的存在情况和发布渠道。

| 权重版本 | 硬件要求 | 发布渠道 |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| BF16（`Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B`） | 1 个 Ascend 950DT（96GB x 8）节点、1 个 Atlas 800 A3（64GB x 16）节点、1 个 Atlas 800 A2（64GB x 8）节点，或 Atlas 300I DUO | ModelScope |
| W8A8（`Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w8a8`） | 1 个 Atlas 800 A3（64GB x 16）节点、1 个 Atlas 800 A2（64GB x 8）节点，或 Atlas 300I DUO | ModelScope |
| W8A8 MXFP8（`Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w8a8-mxfp8`） | 1 个 Ascend 950DT（96GB x 8）节点 | ModelScope |
| W8A8C8 MXFP8（`Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w8a8c8-mxfp8`） | 1 个 Ascend 950DT（96GB x 8）节点 | ModelScope |
| W4A8 MXFP（`Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w4a8-mxfp`） | 1 个 Ascend 950DT（96GB x 8）节点 | ModelScope |

教程中每个权重版本都发布在 ModelScope，因此这里只列出 ModelScope。请将权重下载到多节点共享目录（例如 `/root/.cache/`）并记录路径，部署命令会从该路径加载模型。

prerequisites[1].content.en: Every command below uses `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0` and its per-product tags (`-a3`, `-a5`, `-310p`), the same pins as `model.docker_image` and the tutorial 4.1 image commands. Nightly images are not used: the tutorial configuration fails on `nightly-main-a3` (vLLM Ascend 0.19.1rc2.dev3230+g469c6c260) with a TransData error, as recorded in the verification section. Record the main tutorial commit and the exact image digest when you reproduce a scenario.
prerequisites[1].content.zh: 下文所有命令使用 `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0` 及其分产品标签（`-a3`、`-a5`、`-310p`），与 `model.docker_image` 及教程 4.1 的镜像命令保持一致。这里不使用 nightly 镜像：在 `nightly-main-a3`（vLLM Ascend 0.19.1rc2.dev3230+g469c6c260）上教程配置会因 TransData 报错而失败，详见下文“功能验证”部分。复现场景时请记录 main 教程提交与准确的镜像摘要。

env_setup.container.A3.content.en:
```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3
DEVS=""
for i in $(seq 0 15); do DEVS="$DEVS --device /dev/davinci$i"; done
docker run --rm --name vllm-ascend --net=host --shm-size=1g $DEVS \
  --device /dev/davinci_manager --device /dev/devmm_svm --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/ \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  -v /root/.cache:/root/.cache \
  -it $IMAGE bash
```

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
```bash
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024 ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3000
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1

vllm serve Eco-Tech/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w8a8 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 \
  --data-parallel-size 1 --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --quantization ascend --served-model-name qwen3.6 \
  --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
  --max-num-batched-tokens {{max_num_batched_tokens}} \
  --trust-remote-code --safetensors-load-strategy lazy \
  --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"qwen3_5_mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' \
  --dtype bfloat16 --enable-prefix-caching \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' \
  --additional-config '{"enable_cpu_binding":true,"multistream_overlap_shared_expert":true}'
```

The runtime reports `Transdata op, groups should be greater than 1, but now is 1`. Disabling `multistream_overlap_shared_expert` did not remove the error. The original configuration remains experimental and has not passed end-to-end acceptance on this nightly image.

tuning.en:
For long context, use TP2 or more and reduce `--max-num-seqs` if HBM is insufficient. For high throughput, use multiple local DP groups and tune `--max-num-batched-tokens`. For low latency, prefer full decode ACLGraph and disable speculative decoding by default.

On Atlas 800 A2 this scenario keeps the W8A8 checkpoint, disables expert parallelism and
uses `--dtype bfloat16` to avoid the FP16 activation path that triggers the grouped-matmul
scale dtype limitation on 910B4. This combination starts successfully on the 32 GB A2
runner. Expert parallelism will be restored once vllm-ascend#20702 ships in the public image.

On Atlas 800 A3, the W8A8 scenario uses the same BF16 and no-expert-parallel combination
as a temporary workaround for the public v0.30.0-a3 image. This does not verify the original
FP16 + expert-parallel tutorial scenario, which remains blocked until vllm-ascend#20702 or
an equivalent scale-dtype fix is available in the image.
tuning.zh:
长上下文场景使用 TP2 或更高配置，显存不足时降低 `--max-num-seqs`。高吞吐场景使用多个本地 DP 组并调整 `--max-num-batched-tokens`。低时延场景优先使用全量 Decode ACLGraph，并默认关闭投机解码。

Atlas 800 A2 场景保留 W8A8 权重，关闭专家并行，并使用 `--dtype bfloat16` 避开触发
910B4 grouped-matmul scale dtype 限制的 FP16 激活路径；该组合已在 32 GB A2 runner 上
成功启动。待上游 vllm-ascend#20702 进入公开镜像后，恢复专家并行。

Atlas 800 A3 的 W8A8 场景同样采用 BF16 并关闭专家并行，作为公开 v0.30.0-a3 镜像的
临时绕过方案。这不代表原 FP16 + 专家并行教程场景已通过验证；该场景仍需等待
vllm-ascend#20702 或等价的 scale dtype 修复进入镜像。
